messages:
Asha Nair: Quick sync: IntegratorY marketplace pilot next week. We need a short, unambiguous SI handoff doc for onboarding. Main items: lead ownership window, CRM field names, escalation flows, and co-branded assets.

Ben Foster: Recommendation from Ops: SI gets a 7-day claim window. If SI clicks claim -> ownership extends; if not, auto-return to Redwood SDR. Add a 48h confirm action after claim.

Clara Ruiz: +1. Also define a clear high-intent rule so we don't steal hot trials: high_intent = (usage_pct > 60) OR (seats >= 5) OR (billing_plan == 'enterprise'). If high_intent -> no auto-reassign.

Evan Miles: For SFDC please standardize these fields: lead_source = marketplace_integratory, si_partner_id, si_claimed_at, si_confirmed_at, auto_reassign_at, high_intent_flag, partner_notes. We'll wire automation off auto_reassign_at.

Partner Bot: Saved draft playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/integratory-onboard (viewable) :link:

Asha Nair: Can IntegratorY emit usage webhook so we can set high_intent_flag automatically? Ben, can your eng-ops contact integrate?

Ben Foster: Yes, IntegratorY agreed. They will POST usage events (account_id, usage_pct, active_users). I'll get a sample payload today.

Clara Ruiz: Also request: partner must mark "claimed" in partner dashboard within 48h of noticing lead, otherwise we trigger a reminder email and create a task for their CSM. If still unclaimed by 7d -> auto-reassign.

Evan Miles: Suggested SFDC automation pseudocode:
```
on lead created:
  set lead_source = "marketplace_integratory"
  set auto_reassign_at = created_at + 7d
  if usage_pct incoming webhook >= 60 then set high_intent_flag = true
on partner claim:
  set si_claimed_at = now
  set si_confirmed_at = now + 48h if partner clicks confirm
  cancel auto_reassign if high_intent_flag == true or si_confirmed_at set
```

Asha Nair: Who owns the routing implementation? Ben / Eng-ops? Who updates playbook?

Ben Foster: I'll own routing and webhook intake. Will create JIRA and ping eng-ops for middleware.

Clara Ruiz: I'll own the playbook content and the compliance blurb for marketplace listing. Will post updated Confluence page by EOD Wed.

Partner Bot: Jira created: PART-9023 implement-integratory-routing (assignee: Ben Foster) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PART-9023

Evan Miles: One more ask from sales: export schema for partner CSV handoff. Suggested fields: account_id, company_name, primary_contact, contact_email, lead_created_at, si_partner_id, claimed_at, status, trial_usage_pct, notes.

Asha Nair: Good. We'll include that in the playbook. Marketing: need a co-branded 1-pager + email template supplied before launch. Ben, can IntegratorY confirm logo files and brand guidelines?

Ben Foster: They'll send assets by EOD tomorrow.

Clara Ruiz: Blockers? Any legal/privacy concerns on usage webhook?

Asha Nair: Priya from Legal flagged consent language must be on listing. I'll loop Legal after Clara updates the playbook.

Partner Bot: Reminder: Playbook review meeting Thu 9am PT. Invite sent.

Asha Nair: Thanks all. Action items: Ben -> Jira + webhook sample; Clara -> playbook + privacy blurb; Evan -> SFDC field mapping + pseudocode; I'll coordinate marketing timeline. Will post final sign-off here. :rocket:
